vacancies.title: Driver
vacancies.description: We are seeking a skilled and experienced driver to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a valid driver's license, a clean driving record, and a strong knowledge of traffic laws and regulations. Responsibilities include safely transporting passengers, maintaining the vehicle, and providing excellent customer service.
requirements: Knowledge of traffic laws and regulations

vacancies.title: Conductor
vacancies.description: We are looking for a friendly and responsible conductor to join our team. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to handle cash transactions accurately. Responsibilities include assisting passengers, collecting fares, and ensuring a safe and comfortable journey.
requirements: Positive attitude and customer service orientation
Ability to handle cash transactions accurately
Knowledge of bus routes and schedules
